chunks: Are you afraid of giving alms before conferring? Then, if you cannot do this, and God forgives you, be constant in your devotional obligations and pay the due share of your wealth for the welfare of others, and obey God and His Prophet. God is aware of all you do.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of giving charity before private conversations in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the incident of the Banu Nadir or the companions' private consultations, highlighting the transition from voluntary charity (Sadaqat) to the obligatory dues (Zakat). The divine acceptance of their repentance underscores the mercy of Allah in easing communal obligations, while the subsequent command to 'establish prayer and pay zakat' reinforces the core pillars of worship and obedience to the Prophet as the interpreter of divine will.
